data.task_title: Load and Analyze Pipeline Execution Data

features.title: Performance Bottleneck Identification
features.description: Identify and highlight performance bottlenecks in the pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: System accurately identifies bottlenecks in execution.
Users receive notifications about identified bottlenecks.

features.title: Performance Metrics Calculation
features.description: Implement functionality to calculate execution metrics from ingested data.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are calculated accurately from raw data.
System supports calculation of multiple types of metrics.
Metrics calculation is optimized for performance.

features.title: Optimization Recommendations
features.description: Provide actionable recommendations to optimize pipeline performance.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendations are based on accurate analysis of data.
Users can view and export recommendations.
System tracks the implementation of recommendations.

features.title: Data Ingestion
features.description: Develop a module to ingest pipeline execution data into the analysis system.
acceptance_criteria: Data is successfully ingested from all specified sources.
Ingestion process handles data in various formats.
System logs ingestion errors for troubleshooting.

features.title: Data Visualization
features.description: Create visualizations to present pipeline performance metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Visualizations accurately represent the calculated metrics.
Users can interact with visualizations to explore data.
Visualizations update dynamically with new data.

features.title: Statistical Summaries
features.description: Generate statistical summaries of the pipeline execution data.
acceptance_criteria: Summaries provide insights into performance trends.
Statistical data is presented in an easy-to-understand format.
System supports export of statistical summaries.
